name: Christian Girl Autumn
summary: The aesthetic originated as a viral Twitter meme that initially served to mock a perceived stereotype of "basic" white women.
description: The aesthetic originated as a viral Twitter meme that initially served to mock a perceived stereotype of "basic" white women. However, the term evolved and was largely reclaimed after the real-life influencer pictured in the meme, Caitlin Covington, embraced the title and became its public face. [ 2 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Comfort, coziness, tradition, nostalgia, simple pleasures, curated domesticity

visualDNA.colour: Warm neutrals (beige, cream, tan, brown), earth tones, maroon, burnt orange
